name: see
description: A description and the visible text of each image, from one model call.

verbs.name: describe
verbs.description: Describe one or more images in one model call. Prints one note per image, or the image notes with --json. Cached per image by image hash, model, and prompt hash. Refuses with budget_exceeded once today's model spend reaches the daily budget.

images.description: PNG, JPEG, GIF, or WebP files.
